reason: js/redmaterials.js creates the ripple span with className "ink" on click and appends it to .ripple-effect; it never appears in static markup.

js/redmaterials.js toggles "rdm-ui-disable-scroll" on document.body while the nav sidebar is open; it is runtime-only and cannot appear in static markup.
scss/pagination.scss matches .page-item.disabled .page-link.focus only as the legacy programmatic focus-state alias alongside :focus; .focus is a state, not a class to add to pagination markup.

Bootstrap's Popover JavaScript creates the .popover element at runtime when a [data-bs-toggle="popover"] trigger is activated; it never appears in static markup. The rdm-overlays example exercises the restyled element.

Bootstrap's Tooltip JavaScript creates the .tooltip element at runtime when a [data-bs-toggle="tooltip"] trigger is activated; it never appears in static markup. The rdm-overlays example exercises the restyled element.
